name: FFTA Expansion
notes: Fixes the pre-battle unit Info screen: pressing R on a unit during deployment showed garbled graphics, and closing it could leave a permanent black screen. The cause was 12 KB of memory still reserved by a retired art palette engine; that engine and its reservation are now removed entirely (the artwork already uses the game's native palettes). A memory audit also fixed: the enemy AI's working memory had been accidentally doubled (a cause of rare battle stalls); every action held a large record on the small system stack, so a Mystic Knight Doublecast into Shell came within 56 bytes of crashing (now about 800 bytes of room); reactions such as Counter and Return Magic fired while Petrified, Silenced or otherwise disabled; and two original item-list routines still read the old inventory layout after equipping. A whole-game test pass also fixed: opening a unit's Info or Status could corrupt another unit's saved abilities (the reported stray 'Shieldbearer'/'Blizzara' labels), a Chemist item used on an enemy or empty tile froze the battle, and moving the job wheel off Mystic Knight left a stray fragment. Units in the ten new jobs now earn EXP (they earned none from any action before), and the Chemist's single-ally items no longer also affect adjacent units. All 85 new weapons now have their own inventory and shop icons instead of sharing their family's original icon. Unit Info, Equip Items, Pick Abilities and battle Status keep the full 461-item lists. Saves from 0.7 through 0.7.2 remain compatible; load an in-game save after updating.
